comments.author: Cr4zyTKD
comments.body_html:
Hey Ams, thanks for the mod!

I have been testing the preset without That’s Lit (for performance reasons) and it’s very, VERY, nice. Woods is still unbelievably rough, though.

The biggest annoyance for me was PMC spotting responses. Everytime they would scream “Scav spotted” or “Bad guy over there” and give away their position. They still happen, but now they are super rare (1/2 out of 10 encounters, which is great). Plus, there are no more “Granada Toh” or “I’m reloading” (these intermediate call outs are basically non-existent - big W right there). You either avoid their Lebron throws or rush them while reloading/healing, in both cases, you gotta use sound cues.

Potential fix - there are no more dying responses. Everybody who plays this game know how we have to rely on audio to survive. The problem now is that PMC/Scavs don’t scream when they die to a grenade. I couldn’t care less about bullet wounds (which are non-existent now), but this one kinda sucks. I held a corner for 10min VS Glukhar thinking it was 6vs1 while 3 were already dead just to mention one of the many instances where I was in range. Factory and Labs are especially sad like this.

Played almost 25 raids (45min on average).
